clone_limits: The PGDA78 clones cover the published topographic error model only. They say nothing about radar calibration, sub-pixel rocks or Earth field truth (PRD 6.6).

worldcover.sampling: nearest class at each 90 m cell centre

rank_sensitivity.runs: PGDA78 Site01 clones of the target window, each re-measured through D29 and T3; Earth windows held fixed (no Earth error model)
rank_sensitivity.wording: rank stability is a frequency over clone runs, never a probability

record_type: terraluna G4 candidate table and rank sensitivity
scope: Slice search over the configured Earth regions (outputs/search/targets.json n_compared = 71), terrain families only (Mode C). Not the full T5 search universe.
sort_note: No single order: Pareto layers over terrain_relief and terrain_texture, then window_id; no family sorts first (ANA-03 undecided). No composite exists.
sort_rule: first Pareto layer over terrain_relief, terrain_texture (smaller is closer; encoder excluded while G5 is not PASS); then window_id
tie_rule: matching.tie_groups: |d_a - d_b| < s_a + s_b, s = half width of the candidate's PGDA78 clone 2.5-97.5 percentile distance range (measurement error only)
